body:
# AllCoreDevs - Execution (ACDE) #216 (July 17, 2025)

- [Jul 17, 2025, 14:00 UTC](https://notime.zone/OUk16Omxyxwmb)
- [Ethereum Protocol Calls Calendar subscription](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t)

# Agenda 

- Fusaka
    - devnet updates
    - [Upgrade timelines](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#timelines)
         - After Pectra, we agreed to have a 30 day window between client releases and both the [first testnet fork](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#testnets) and [mainnet](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/processes/protocol-upgrade.md#mainnet). 
         - Assuming we followed this and wanted to deliver Fusaka before Devconnect, this implies: 
             - Mainnet ~> Nov 5-12
             - Last testnet ~> Oct 6-10
             - First testnet ~> Sep 22 - Oct 3
             - **Client testnet releases** ~> Week of Aug 25
          - Is this realistic? 
             - [@ralexstokes counter-proposal](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1610#issuecomment-3075167383)
             - [PeerDAS todos](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1610#issuecomment-3075401629)
             - Holesky fork? 
      - EIP-7907
      - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9986
- [Glamsterdam Planning](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7773-glamsterdam-network-upgrade-meta-thread/21195)
    - Next 2 ACDE focused on headliner discussions
        - Client team preferences
            - [Geth](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1610#issuecomment-3073521193)
            - [Reth](https://hackmd.io/@ZPrq5kalQqSX-138YNSJUQ/H1JafRXLle)
            - [Erigon](https://hackmd.io/@erigon/Glamsterdam_Headliners_View)
            - [Nethermind](https://hackmd.io/@nethermindclient/Syqj3VUUxg)
            - [Besu](https://hackmd.io/@RoboCopsGoneMad/Ski-5cHLge)
            - [Lighthouse](https://blog.sigmaprime.io/glamsterdam-headliner.html)
            - [Prysm](https://hackmd.io/@tchain/prysm-glamsterdam-headliner)
            - [Grandine](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1610#issuecomment-3078680887)
            - [Lodestar](https://blog.chainsafe.io/lodestars-glamsterdam-headliner-vision/)
            - [Teku](https://hackmd.io/@teku/SJeW2JULlx)
        - Most important open questions 
        - Scheduling live discussions 
        - Broader community input
    -  EIP PFI deadline?
        - August 21 (end of headliner selection)?
        - Sep/Oct?
        - Fusaka shipping? 

<details> <summary>🤖 config</summary>

- Duration in minutes : 90
- Recurring meeting : true
- Call series : acde
- Occurrence rate : bi-weekly
- Already a Zoom meeting ID : true
- Already on Ethereum Calendar : true
- Need YouTube stream links : true 
- Facilitator email: tim@ethereum.org
Note: The zoom link will be sent to the facilitator via email

</details>

**Discourse Topic ID:** 24770
- Action: Updated at 2025-07-17 14:01 UTC
- URL: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/24770

**Zoom Meeting:** Reusing meeting 88269836469 for series 'acde'.
- *Zoom link hidden (sent to facilitator email)*

**Existing YouTube Stream Links (Reused):**
- Stream 1 (Jul 17, 2025): https://youtube.com/watch?v=dkIQxIHX56E

**Calendar Event:** Reusing existing event for series.
- [Approximate Google Calendar Link](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=02cu1b1g1mscunv7d3p0ilg3gg)
- Skipping email notification (already processed issue #1610 before).

**Telegram Notification**
- Updated message for this occurrence to Ethereum Protocol Updates channel
General question: How do EIP authors present potential EIPs? Is it like a full-blown presentation, or is it more of a "show up and talk" type situation?

> General question: How do EIP authors present potential EIPs? Is it like a full-blown presentation, or is it more of a "show up and talk" type situation?

heya! Propose it as an agenda item on the issue for the relevant ACD (execution vs. consensus) and the moderator (execution: Tim, consensus: Alex) will add it to the agenda if appropriate. Having a 5-min (really 5 min!) presentation is good

It's also good to indicate whether you mean to present for general feedback from a specific group or proposing for a specific fork - Fusaka scope is frozen, Glamsterdam is still looking at only headliners at the moment, so if you mean it for a specific fork, you may have to wait until Glamsterdam is soliciting non-headliner EIPs
Timeline here: https://forkcast.org/upgrade/glamsterdam#glamsterdam-timeline

In general, the first step is making sure you have an Ethereum Magicians post for it first, which it looks like you already do (7932?)?

I'd like to discuss lowering the tx gas limit cap in EIP-7825 as done in the PR here:
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9986

Otherwise, I'd propose that we consider this EIP in glamsterdam:
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9984

Carried out some analysis alongside:
https://github.com/nerolation/eth-16m-gas-cap-analysis/blob/main/eip_7983_comprehensive_analysis.ipynb

> heya! Propose it as an agenda item on the issue for the relevant ACD (execution vs. consensus) and the moderator (execution: Tim, consensus: Alex) will add it to the agenda if appropriate. Having a 5-min (really 5 min!) presentation is good
> 
> It's also good to indicate whether you mean to present for general feedback from a specific group or proposing for a specific fork - Fusaka scope is frozen, Glamsterdam is still looking at only headliners at the moment, so if you mean it for a specific fork, you may have to wait until Glamsterdam is soliciting non-headliner EIPs Timeline here: https://forkcast.org/upgrade/glamsterdam#glamsterdam-timeline
> 
> In general, the first step is making sure you have an Ethereum Magicians post for it first, which it looks like you already do (7932?)?

Thank you for this info, I'll wait until Glamsterdam opens up to Non-Headliner proposals.

The Geth team supports EIP-7928 "Block-Level Access Lists" as the headliner proposal for the Glamsterdam fork. We would very much like to see the design include an improvement for the snap sync 'healing phase' alongside the support for parallel tx execution.

Assessment of all EL headliner proposals: https://notes.ethereum.org/@fjl/glamsterdam-headliner-el
@nerolation your PR was merged, anything else to discuss on ACDE?

i'd like to toss another option for fusaka mainnet timing that leaves a little less room around testnets to give us a bit more time to harden implementations.

note: this is all assuming happy paths; if e.g. there is a significant failure on a testnet, we will have to revise the schedule.

1 Sep - RC client releases
15 or 22 Sep - Sepolia
< 2 or 3 weeks>
6 Oct - Hoodi
< 30 days>
5 Nov - mainnet

from today, this implies we have the rest of July to get any last minute spec things sorted and devnet-3 live and healthy, all of August can be devoted to hardening implementations, and then we move to the deployment pipeline in September

As far as peerDAS is concerned on the CL side, before running any testnet, we should at least:
- Ensure all clients can sync in the "perfect peerDAS" configuration. (aka. [perfect_peerdas_enabled: true](https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) on Kurtosis)
- Ensure all clients perform well without [engine_getBlobsV2](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/osaka.md#engine_getblobsv2). (Using private blob txs in devnets can do the job.)
[Prysm team's preference on glamsterdam headliner](https://hackmd.io/@tchain/prysm-glamsterdam-headliner)

Grandine team prefers [eip-7732](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7732) as Glamsterdman headliner for CL. However, our opinion may change after we hear more community input on this and other EIPs. As I mentioned in the previous ACD, we should focus on community input.

[Erigon team's preference on Glamsterdam headliners](https://hackmd.io/@erigon/Glamsterdam_Headliners_View) - It's indicative and not comprehensive or absolute, intended to help in making the final decision rather than dictating it.
Lodestar put our Glamsterdam headliners proposals (yes two!) thoughts here: https://blog.chainsafe.io/lodestars-glamsterdam-headliner-vision/

> full-blown presentation

@SirSpudlington please also share your slides to your max 5 minute presentation on the agenda ahead of time.

📅 AllCoreDevs - Execution (ACDE) #216 X/Twitter Stream: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1OdKrDBpZLQJX

📣 Promote ACDE Meeting 216 on X/Twitter: http://bit.ly/4ls8fT3
Here is Teku's team position for Glamsterdam: https://hackmd.io/@teku/SJeW2JULlx
We should probably do a quick upgrade of holesky before doing an upgrade of other testnets, maybe 1st sept or similar, IIRC its due to be de-supported in September so it's the lowest risk network.
I'd like to (re-)propose EIP-7819 for inclusion in Glamsterdam.

> I'd like to (re-)propose EIP-7819 for inclusion in Glamsterdam.

@Amxx you should submit a PR to Glamsterdam EIP to add as PFI.

From: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7773-glamsterdam-network-upgrade-meta-thread/21195
> Like for Fusaka, EIP authors proposing their EIP should submit a PR against the Glamsterdam Meta EIP, following the process detailed in [EIP-7723](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7723#proposed-for-inclusion).
The deadline for EIPs being PFI’d for Glamsterdam should be August 21.

Nethermind's team position on Glamsterdam Headliners:
https://hackmd.io/@nethermindclient/Syqj3VUUxg

Besu's team position on Glamsterdam Headliners:

https://hackmd.io/@RoboCopsGoneMad/Ski-5cHLge

> I'd like to (re-)propose EIP-7819 for inclusion in Glamsterdam.

Don't think we've got to Glamsterdam EIPs, just headliners so far
closing in lieu of #1629
